findings.nanoscale_evidence: Anatase particles had reported lengths approximately20-110nm in Discussion (broader abstract claim20-140nm); not all longest dimensions are below100nm.

equipment.claim: A Teflon-lined stainless-steel high-pressure autoclave was used for hydrothermal TiO2 nanoparticle synthesis.
equipment.scope: No manufacturer, vessel capacity or model reported.

equipment.claim: Precursor solution was filtered before hydrothermal treatment.
equipment.scope: Filter type and make/model unspecified; class association only.

findings.integration_recommendation: Add independent class-level evidence for M05 and N02. Existing P15 specifically concerns doped metal oxides; this undoped TiO2 study may support a broadened hydrothermal parent route only if the displayed claim retains the TiO2 scope. Do not silently claim doped synthesis.

conceptual_steps.label: Prepare and adjust the titanium precursor solution
Filter the precursor solution
Hydrothermally form TiO2 nanoparticles

caveats: No microwave heating was used or inferred.
Nitrogen sparging does not establish a particular Schlenk manifold model.
No new commercial model is warranted.
